test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.**

Reptiles _________ from amphibians. For a long period of 160 million years in earth’s history, reptiles were the dominant form of life on the planet and _________ in an enormous variety of shapes and sizes.
solution:
The correct answer is: **evolved; existed**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Evolved **means developed gradually over time through natural selection. (प्राकृतिक चयन के माध्यम से समय के साथ धीरे-धीरे विकसित हुआ)

 
 
• **For example- ***Technology has evolved rapidly in the past decade.*
 
 
 
• **Existed **means to have an actual being; be real or in existence. (एक वास्तविक अस्तित्व होना; वास्तविक हो या अस्तित्व में हो)
 
 
• **For example- ***Ancient civilizations existed long before our time.*
 
 
 
• The sentence is talking about the evolution of reptiles and their existence on Earth.
 
• The use of "and" indicates that the two blanks require two separate words.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

**Complete sentence**: *Reptiles evolved __from amphibians. For a long period of 160 million years in Earth’s history, reptiles were the dominant form of life on the planet and __existed __in an enormous variety of shapes and sizes.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the other words.
 
 
• **Developed**: Evolved or progressed to a more advanced state. (अधिक उन्नत अवस्था में विकसित या प्रगति करना)
 
• **Continued**: Persisted or carried on without interruption. (बिना किसी रुकावट के कायम या जारी रहना)
 
• **Came**: Arrived at a location or a certain state. (किसी स्थान या निश्चित राज्य पर पहुँचना)
 
• **Exhausted**: Completely drained of energy or resources. (ऊर्जा या संसाधनों का पूरी तरह से ख़त्म हो जाना)
 
• **Involved**: Participated or engaged in a situation or activity. (किसी स्थिति या गतिविधि में भाग लेना या संलग्न होना)
 
• **Lived**: Resided in a particular place or experienced life in a certain way. (किसी विशेष स्थान पर निवास किया या एक निश्चित तरीके से जीवन का अनुभव किया)
